dedupe_keys.name: 和歌山県 障害特性に配慮した福祉避難所 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: 【和歌山県】障害特性に配慮した福祉避難所 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 和歌山県内の、障害特性に配慮した福祉避難所を掲載しています。 障害特性に配慮した福祉避難所ﾏｯﾌﾟご利用にあたっては、以下の利用条件をご確認ください。 （１）障害特性に配慮した福祉避難所とは 災害発生時に、一般の避難所での生活に支障をきたす障害者等災害時要配慮者を受け入れるため、障害特性によって特別な配慮がなされた福祉避難所のことです... Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are マップ, 位置情報, 施設, 災害, 福祉. It offers 33 resource(s) in csv, geojson, html, kml, zip. The portal shows 2022-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
